english.title: Sell / offer to sell a medicinal product by automatic machine when not subject to general sale
english.standardoffencewording:

english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 222, 255(6)(b) and (7) of the Human Medicines Regulations 2012.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Regulations 339(1) of the Human Medicines Regulations 2012 provides that a magistrates' court in England or Wales may try an information for an offence under these Regulations that is triable only summarily if the information was laid at any time within the period of twelve months beginning with the commission of the offence.
